detaileddescription.para: WARNING This documentation is a work in progress and does not reflect the full MPI plugin potential.

MPI plugin defines 2 types in PDI:
MPI_Comm - C MPI_Comm type
MPI_Comm_f - Fortran MPI_Comm type

MPI plugin exposes several metadata that correspond with mpi library.
MPI_COMM_WORLD_rank - an integer value, represents the rank of the process in the MPI_COMM_WORLD
MPI_COMM_WORLD - a MPI_Comm, MPI_COMM_WORLD for C language
MPI_COMM_SELF - a MPI_Comm, MPI_COMM_SELF for C language
MPI_COMM_NULL - a MPI_Comm, MPI_COMM_NULL for C language
MPI_COMM_WORLD_F - an integer, MPI_COMM_WORLD for Fortran language
MPI_COMM_SELF_F - an integer, MPI_COMM_SELF for Fortran language
MPI_COMM_NULL_F - an integer, MPI_COMM_NULL for Fortran language
All above metadata are available from PDI_init call to PDI_finalize call.

The plugin can also transtype communicators between C and Fortran: each time a source communicator is shared, the transtyped communicator is shared under a destination name. When the source is released, if it was shared with write access, the value of the destination is transtyped back into it, then the destination is released.

sect1.para: The configuration of the MPI plugin, empty (~) or a mapping with the keys below.
Optional. A mapping, the C communicators (MPI_Comm) to transtype to Fortran ones (MPI_Comm_f).
A scalar, the name under which to share the Fortran communicator transtyped from the C communicator named <data_name>.
Optional. A mapping, the Fortran communicators (MPI_Comm_f) to transtype to C ones (MPI_Comm).
A scalar, the name under which to share the C communicator transtyped from the Fortran communicator named <data_name>.
Optional, deprecated. A mapping, the communicators to transtype, use plugins.mpi.Comm_c2f and plugins.mpi.Comm_f2c instead.

A scalar, the name under which to share the communicator transtyped from the communicator named <data_name>. The direction of the transtyping depends on the type of <data_name>: C to Fortran for a MPI_Comm, Fortran to C otherwise.
Optional. The configuration of the logger of the plugin, see plugins.<plugin_name>.logging.
